l-m-h2-b0d01-01.title: Ingaba log(a+b)=log a+log b yenzeka rhoqo?
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.goal: Jonga ukuba isibakala log₂(a+b)=log₂a+log₂b siyinyani rhoqo na, uze ufumane kwaye uchaze imeko apho singasebenzi (umzekelo ochasayo).
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.material: Isibakala: kumanani apositive a no-b, log₂(a+b) = log₂a + log₂b yenzeka rhoqo. Fumana u-a no-b ababonisa ukuba esi sibakala asichanekanga.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s1.prompt: Ngu-a no-b bangaphi ngumzekelo ochasayo wesibakala?
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s1.r.a: log₂4=2 kunye no-1+1=2, ngoko iyabambeka. Asingomzekelo ochasayo.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s1.r.b: a+b=ab=9/2, ngoko la maxabiso mabini ayalingana. Asingomzekelo ochasayo.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s1.r.c: a+b=ab=16/3, ngoko la maxabiso mabini ayalingana. Asingomzekelo ochasayo.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s1.explain: Ukuba a=b=4, log₂8=3 kodwa log₂4+log₂4=4. Isibalo seelogarithm sihambelana nemveliso yeengxoxo.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s2.model.0: Ukuba a=b=4, log₂8=3 kodwa log₂4+log₂4=4, ngoko amaxabiso amabini ayahluka kwaye ngumzekelo ochasayo.
l-m-h2-b0d01-01.s.s2.model.1: log₂a+log₂b=log₂(ab), ngoko ayalingana kuphela xa a+b=ab. Kuba 4+4≠16, a=b=4 ngumzekelo ochasayo.

l-m-h2-b0d01-10.s.s1.r.c: Kwi-x=2 nowe-4, aˣ=x, ngoko amagrafu amabini adibana.
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.s.s1.explain: Ukuba a=2, ngoko 2ˣ>x, ngoko x>log₂x. 2ˣ ingaphezu kwe-y=x kwaye log₂x ingaphantsi kwayo, ngoko azidibani.
l-m-h2-b0d01-10.s.s2.model.0: Ukuba a=2, ngoko 2ˣ>x kwaye x>log₂x, ngoko y=2ˣ ingaphezu kwe-y=x kwaye y=log₂x ingaphantsi kwe-y=x, kwaye azidibani.

l-m-h2-b0d05-03.title: Ngaba P(A|B) kunye ne-P(B|A) ziyalingana rhoqo?
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.goal: Hlola ukuba ibango elithi "P(A|B) kunye ne-P(B|A) ziyalingana rhoqo" lisoloko liyinyaniso na, kwaye ufumane uchaze imeko apho lingenjalo (umzekelo ochasayo).
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.material: Ibango: Kwizehlo ezimbini A no-B, amathuba anemiqathango P(A|B) kunye ne-P(B|A) ayalingana rhoqo. Vavanya eli bango ngezibini zezehlo ezingezantsi zokuphosa idayisi kanye.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.prompt: Khetha izehlo A no-B ezichasene nebango.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.o.a: A: even, B: ezi-4 okanye ngaphantsi
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.o.b: A: odd, B: ezi-3 okanye ngaphantsi
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.r.b: Zombini zinemiphumo emi-3 kwaye A∩B={1, 3}, ngoko amaxabiso omabini ayalingana kwi-2/3.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.o.c: A: ezi-3 okanye ngaphantsi, B: ezi-4 okanye ngaphezulu
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.r.c: A∩B yiseti engenanto, ngoko amaxabiso omabini ayalingana kwi-0.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.r.d: Sisehlo esinye, ngoko amaxabiso omabini ayalingana kwi-1.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s1.explain: P(A|B)=n(A∩B)/n(B) kunye ne-P(B|A)=n(A∩B)/n(A). Kwi-even nezi-4 okanye ngaphantsi, ziyahluka: 1/2 kunye ne-2/3.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s2.model.0: Ukuba A=even kwaye B=ezi-4 okanye ngaphantsi, ngoko P(A|B)=2/4=1/2 kwaye P(B|A)=2/3, ngoko amaxabiso amabini ayahluka. Ngoko ngumzekelo ochasayo.
l-m-h2-b0d05-03.s.s2.model.1: Abahlulahlulo bayahluka, n(B)=4 kunye ne-n(A)=3, ngoko nangona A∩B ifanayo yemiphumo emi-2, amathuba amabini anemiqathango ayahluka.

l-m-h2-b0d02-15.material: Sifuna ukufumana ixesha kwigrafu yohlobo luka-y=a sin(bx+c)+d. Liliphi kumaxabiso a, b, c, d eliyimfuneko ngokupheleleyo? (a no-b abango-0.)
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s1.r.a: I-a igqiba ubude bamaza. Ayinasiphelo nexesha.
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s1.r.b: I-c igqiba kuphela ukutshintsha ngasekhohlo nasekunene. Ixesha lihlala linjalo.
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s1.r.c: I-d igqiba kuphela ukutshintsha ngaphezulu nangaphantsi. Ixesha lihlala linjalo.
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s1.explain: Ixesha yi-2π/|b|. I-a igqiba ubude bamaza, i-c ukutshintsha ngasekhohlo nasekunene, kwaye i-d ukutshintsha ngaphezulu nangaphantsi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s2.model.0: Ixesha ligqitywa yi-2π/|b|, ngoko kufuneka wazi kuphela ixabiso eliphelele luka-b. I-a, i-c, ne-d zihambisa okanye zikhulisa umbo nje.
l-m-h2-b0d02-15.s.s2.model.1: Ukolula okanye ukuhambisa igrafu ngaphezulu nangaphantsi akutshintshi ubude obuthe tye bokuphinda kanye, ngoko yi-b kuphela, ecinezela icala elithe tye, egqiba ixesha.

l-m-h2-b0d03-02.s.s1.r.a: Amakhowefishiyenti amalungu anedigri esezantsi akanqumi umda.
l-m-h2-b0d03-02.s.s1.o.b: Amadigri namakhowefishiyenti amalungu anedigri ephezulu yamanani asentla nangaphantsi
l-m-h2-b0d03-02.s.s1.r.c: Le yingxaki ka-x→∞, ngoko ixabiso ku-x=0 alinamsebenzi.
l-m-h2-b0d03-02.s.s1.r.d: Impembelelo yamalungu angaguqukiyo iba mncinci xa u-x ekhula.
l-m-h2-b0d03-02.s.s1.explain: Xa u-x emkhulu kakhulu, ilungu elinedigri ephezulu liyalawula isivakalisi. Ukuba amadigri ayalingana, sisondela kumlinganiselo wamakhowefishiyenti, 3/2.
l-m-h2-b0d03-02.s.s2.model.0: Amalungu anedigri ephezulu ayalawula isivakalisi, njengenani elingasentla 3x² nelingaphantsi 2x², ngoko umlinganiselo wala makhowefishiyenti, 3/2, ngumda.
l-m-h2-b0d03-02.s.s2.model.1: Xa u-x emkhulu kakhulu, amalungu anedigri esezantsi angashiywa, ngoko ukwazi kuphela amadigri namakhowefishiyenti amalungu anedigri ephezulu kunquma umda.

l-m-h2-b0d05-10.title: Siyenza njani ibe yimeko eqhelekileyo ithuba lokusabalalisa okuqhelekileyo?
l-m-h2-b0d05-10.goal: Cinga ukuba ngumgangatho (ulwazi) onjani ofuneka ngokupheleleyo ukufumana ixabiso le-P(X≥a) kwi-normal distribution N(m, σ²), uze uchaze isizathu sokuwukhetha.
l-m-h2-b0d05-10.material: Xa ivariyebhile engaqhelekanga X ilandela i-normal distribution N(m, σ²), sifuna ukufumana i-P(X≥a) ngetheyibhile yokusabalalisa okuqhelekileyo okusemgangathweni. Cinga ukuba ngawaphi amaxabiso afuneka ngokupheleleyo ekwenzeni imeko eqhelekileyo.
l-m-h2-b0d05-10.s.s1.r.a: Ngaphandle kwe-σ, asikwazi ukuthi u-a ukude ngee-σ ezingaphi nomndilili.
l-m-h2-b0d05-10.s.s1.r.b: Ngaphandle komndilili m, asikwazi ukuthi u-a mkhulu okanye mncinci kunomndilili.
l-m-h2-b0d05-10.s.s1.r.c: Ubungakanani besampuli abusetyenziswa ekwenzeni imeko eqhelekileyo; m no-σ ziyafuneka.
l-m-h2-b0d05-10.s.s1.explain: Senza imeko eqhelekileyo nge-Z=(X-m)/σ, ngoko m no-σ ziyafuneka, yaye ixabiso lesalathiso a esilifunayo liyafuneka nalo.
l-m-h2-b0d05-10.s.s2.model.0: Kufuneka siguqule sibe yi-Z=(a-m)/σ, ngoko umndilili m, ukutenxa okuqhelekileyo σ, nexabiso lesalathiso a zonke ziyafuneka. Ukuba nayiphi na iyasilela, asikwazi ukufumana i-Z.
l-m-h2-b0d05-10.s.s2.model.1: Nge-m kuphela asikwazi ukwahlula nge-σ, yaye nge-σ kuphela asikwazi ukukhupha umndilili, ngoko onke amaxabiso amathathu kufuneka anikwe ukwenza imeko eqhelekileyo.

l-m-h2-b0d03-25.material: Isantya apho amanzi engena khona kwitanki ngu-v(t)=3t²+1 (L/umzuzu). Ngu-1 xa t=0, 4 xa t=1, kunye no-13 xa t=2. Qikelela isixa samanzi esingena kwimizuzu ema-2 yokuqala.
l-m-h2-b0d03-25.s.s1.prompt: Luluphi uqikelelo olulungileyo lwesixa samanzi esingenileyo?
l-m-h2-b0d03-25.s.s1.r.a: Ucinge ukuba isantya sokuqala se-1L/umzuzu siyaqhubeka. Isantya siqhubeka sikhula.
l-m-h2-b0d03-25.s.s1.r.c: Oku kusebenzisa isantya sokugqibela 13 kwimizuzu ema-2 yonke, ngoko kukhulu kakhulu.
l-m-h2-b0d03-25.s.s1.r.d: Kukhulu nangakumbi kune-26L, esekelwe kwisantya esiphezulu, ngoko akunakwenzeka.
l-m-h2-b0d03-25.s.s1.explain: Isantya siguquka sisuka ku-1 siye ku-13, ngoko isibalo sizonke siphakathi kwe-2 ne-26L. Ukuqikelela ngesantya esiphakathi 4 kunika malunga ne-8, kwaye isixa sokwenene yi-10L.
l-m-h2-b0d03-25.s.s2.model.0: Isantya siphakathi kwe-1 ne-13, ngoko isibalo sizonke siphakathi kwe-2 ne-26. Ukuba isantya esiphakathi se-4 siqhubeka kwimizuzu ema-2, ngu-8 malunga, ngoko i-8 ukuya kwi-12L iyamkeleka.
l-m-h2-b0d03-25.s.s2.model.1: Phindaphinda isantya esiphakathi 4, hayi isantya sokuqala 1 okanye sokugqibela 13, ngemizuzu ema-2 ufumane malunga ne-8, ngoko siqikelela malunga ne-8 ukuya kwi-12L.

l-m-h2-b0d04-04.title: Ngokomalunga ukuba kungakanani (√(1+x)−1)/x xa x=0.001?
l-m-h2-b0d04-04.goal: Qikelela ixabiso le-(√(1+x)−1)/x kwi-x=0.001 ukuze ugqibe ngobungakanani okanye uluhlu olufanelekileyo, uze uchaze ukuqiqa kwakho.
l-m-h2-b0d04-04.material: Ukuba ufaka x=0.001 kwi-f(x)=(√(1+x)−1)/x, zombini inani elingasentla nelingaphantsi zisondele kakhulu ku-0. Qikelela ubungakanani be-f(0.001) ngaphandle kwekhalkyuleyitha.
l-m-h2-b0d04-04.s.s1.r.a: Nokuba inani elingasentla lincinci, elingaphantsi lincinci nalo, ngoko umlinganiselo awungo-0.
l-m-h2-b0d04-04.s.s1.r.d: Eli lixabiso lokufunda iqhezu libheke ngaphantsi.
l-m-h2-b0d04-04.s.s1.explain: Ukwenza isiseko sibe nobume obuhambelana nenani eliphelele kunika f(x)=1/(√(1+x)+1). Xa x≈0, inani elingaphantsi lingama-2, ngoko i-f ingama-0.5.
l-m-h2-b0d04-04.s.s2.model.0: Ukwenza inani elingasentla libe nobume obuhambelana nenani eliphelele kunika 1/(√(1+x)+1), yaye xa x isondele ku-0 inani elingaphantsi lingama-2, ngoko ixabiso lingama-0.5.
l-m-h2-b0d04-04.s.s2.model.1: √(1+x) inkulu kancinci kuphela kune-1, ngoko inani elingasentla lingesiqingatha se-x, yaye ukwahlula nge-x kunika malunga ne-0.5.

l-m-h2-b0d04-13.title: Ukuba senza i-1 ngaphezulu, iindleko zinyuka ngakanani?
l-m-h2-b0d04-13.goal: Qikelela iindleko ezinyukayo xa senza i-1 emva kwe-100 ukuze ugqibe ngobungakanani okanye uluhlu olufanelekileyo, uze uchaze ukuqiqa kwakho.
l-m-h2-b0d04-13.material: Iindleko zi-C(x)=x²+10x (kwiiyunithi ze-10,000 won). Okwangoku senza izinto ezingama-x=100. Sebenzisa i-C'(100) ukuqikelela iindleko ezinyukayo xa senza i-1 ngaphezulu.
l-m-h2-b0d04-13.s.s1.r.a: Wajonga kuphela ikoyifishenti 10 ye-10x. Washiya ukunyuka okuvela kwi-x².
l-m-h2-b0d04-13.s.s1.r.b: Wathatha inani lezinto, 100, njengeendleko njengoko linjalo.
l-m-h2-b0d04-13.s.s1.explain: C'(x)=2x+10, ngoko C'(100)=210. Iindleko ezinyukayo xa senza i-1 ngaphezulu zimalunga ne-210 × 10,000 won, yaye ixabiso lokwenyani yi-211 × 10,000 won.
l-m-h2-b0d04-13.s.s2.model.0: Ukunyuka xa senza i-1 ngaphezulu kusondele kwizinga lotshintsho lwangoko C'(100)=2·100+10=210, ngoko kumalunga ne-210 × 10,000 won.
l-m-h2-b0d04-13.s.s2.model.1: Ekubeni x itshintsha nge-1 kuphela, utshintsho lweendleko yi-C'(100)×1≈210, nto leyo ihleli ifana nokubala kwenyani, 211.

l-m-h2-b0d04-20.title: Umthamo ukhula ngokungakanani xa icala elinye lekyubhu lolulwa?
l-m-h2-b0d04-20.goal: Qikelela utshintsho lomthamo xa icala likhula ukusuka kwi-10 cm ukuya kwi-10.1 cm, goba ubungakanani okanye uluhlu olufanelekileyo, uchaze ingqiqo.
l-m-h2-b0d04-20.material: Xa icala lekyubhu lingu-x, umthamo ngu-V(x)=x³. Sebenzisa u-V'(10) ukuqikelela ukuba umthamo wonyuka ngokungakanani xa icala likhula ukusuka kwi-10 cm ukuya kwi-10.1 cm.
l-m-h2-b0d04-20.s.s1.r.a: Kuphindaphindwe u-0.1 ngo-3 kuphela. Ithambeka li-3x²=300.
l-m-h2-b0d04-20.s.s1.r.c: Kuthathwe u-x²=100 njengotshintsho. Udinga u-3x² no-0.1.
l-m-h2-b0d04-20.s.s1.explain: Kuba u-V'(10)=300, utshintsho ≈ 300×0.1=30. Utshintsho lokwenene ngu-1030.301−1000=30.301 cm³.
l-m-h2-b0d04-20.s.s2.model.0: Izinga lotshintsho lomthamo ngu-V'(10)=3·10²=300, ngoko xa icala likhula nge-0.1, umthamo ukhula malunga no-300×0.1=30 cm³.
l-m-h2-b0d04-20.s.s2.model.1: Kutshintsho oluncinci, utshintsho yi-derivative iphindaphindwe ngobubanzi botshintsho, ngoko 300×0.1=30, nto leyo isondele ku-30.301 wokwenene.

l-m-h2-b0d06-22.s.s2.model.1: Ithuba alinakudlula kwi-1, ngoko u-1.1 akalunganga. Ukukhupha i-P(A∩B) kumthetho wokudibanisa kunika u-0.7.

l-m-h2-b0d01-05.s.s1.explain: logₐb=x iyafana ne-aˣ=b. Ukusuka ku-8ˣ=4, 2³ˣ=2², ngoko x=2/3.

l-m-h2-b0d02-19.title: Ukuchaza Igrafu ye-cos Njengokuhanjiswa Kwegrafu ye-sin
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.goal: Tshintsha inkcazo ye-y=cosx njengokuhanjiswa kwe-y=sinx ibe yenye indlela yokubonisa (ibinzana, itheyibhile, umfanekiso, okanye amagama), uze uchaze ukuba kutheni ithetha into enye.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.material: Sifuna ukuveza igrafu ye-y=cos x njengokuhanjiswa kwegrafu ye-y=sin x.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.r.b: Ukuhambisa ngaphezulu kudibanisa nje i-π/2 kumaxabiso ka-y, kwahlukile kwi-cos x.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.r.c: sin(x−π)=−sin x, ngoko ayiyo i-cos x.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.r.d: sin(x−π/2)=−cos x, ngoko ijikisiwe ibheke phantsi.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s1.explain: cos x=sin(x+π/2). Ukuhambisa igrafu ye-sin ngasekhohlo nge-π/2 kunika igrafu ye-cos.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s2.model.0: Ekubeni cos x=sin(x+π/2), yi-y=sin x apho x itshintshwe yi-x+π/2, oko kukuthi, igrafu ehanjiswe ngasekhohlo nge-π/2.
l-m-h2-b0d02-19.s.s2.model.1: I-sin x ifikelela ku-1 kwi-x=π/2 kwaye i-cos x ifikelela ku-1 kwi-x=0, ngoko ukuhambisa igrafu ye-sin ngasekhohlo nge-π/2 kuyenza ihambelane negrafu ye-cos.

l-m-h2-b0d04-29.s.s2.model.1: T=4 inika ama-16 L, angonelanga, kwaye T=6 inika ama-36 L, aphuphumayo. Phakathi kwe-4.5 neye-5, ezihlangabezana neemeko, eyona iphambili, i-4.5, yeyona ilungileyo.

l-m-h2-b0d04-30.s.s1.r.c: Ihlangabezana nemeko, kodwa umgama owahanjwayo mde ngakumbi, uma-15 m.
l-m-h2-b0d04-30.s.s1.r.d: Ikwi-12 m ukusuka apho yaqala khona, kodwa ibuyela umva emva kweesekondi ezi-4 kwaye ihamba ngama-20 m ngokuphela.
